description: Complete tech tree for Orion Reborn. 8 research categories with 8 levels each. Effects are designed to integrate with the economy.json model.

research_cost_scaling.notes: Costs increase significantly at higher levels. Actual cost also modified by research allocation and planet bonuses.

levels.name: Hydroponic Farms
levels.description: Basic hydroponics increase food output on all planets.

levels.name: Improved Fertilizers
levels.description: Better agricultural techniques boost planetary growth rates.

levels.name: Genetic Engineering
levels.description: Unlocks the Cloning Center planetary building.

levels.name: Advanced Cloning
levels.description: Significantly faster population growth across the empire.

levels.name: Bio-Enhancement
levels.description: Population works more efficiently and planets can support slightly more people.

levels.name: Cybernetic Life Support
levels.description: Reduces the growth penalty from crowding.

levels.name: Evolutionary Jump
levels.description: All planets gain a flat +1 population per turn.

levels.name: Immortal Biology
levels.description: Eliminates natural population decay. Massive growth on rich and ultra-rich worlds.

levels.name: Automated Factories
levels.description: Basic automation increases output from every factory.

levels.name: Improved Robotics I
levels.description: Population can operate more factories efficiently.

levels.name: Mega-Factories
levels.description: Larger, more efficient factory complexes.

levels.name: Deep Core Mining
levels.description: Rich and Ultra-Rich planets gain significant production bonuses.

levels.name: Improved Robotics II
levels.description: Further increases the number of factories each citizen can operate.

levels.name: Orbital Construction Yards
levels.description: Enables construction of larger ship hulls and faster ship building.

levels.name: Nano-Construction
levels.description: Dramatically increases factory efficiency and reduces build costs.

levels.name: Universal Constructor
levels.description: Peak robotics. Population operates 5 factories each with auto-repairing buildings.

levels.name: Basic AI
levels.description: Early computer systems improve research output.

levels.name: Targeting Computers
levels.description: Improves accuracy of beam weapons in combat.

levels.name: Combat Computers
levels.description: General combat bonuses for all ships.

levels.name: Multi-Tasking AI
levels.description: AI assists in factory management.

levels.name: Sentient AI
levels.description: Unlocks Android Workers — population that does not require food.

levels.name: Neural Networks
levels.description: Empire-wide research acceleration.

levels.name: Quantum Computing
levels.description: Significant boost to all industrial output.

levels.name: Godlike AI
levels.description: Immense bonuses across the board, with risk of AI rebellion.

energy.focus: Power generation, shields, and energy weapons

levels.name: Nuclear Fusion
levels.description: Improved planetary power plants increase production.

levels.name: Laser Weapons
levels.description: Unlocks basic laser batteries for ships.

levels.name: Shields I
levels.description: Basic deflector shields become available.

levels.name: Plasma Weapons
levels.description: Powerful mid-game energy weapons.

levels.name: Fusion Beams + Shields II
levels.description: Advanced shields and powerful beam weapons.

levels.name: Antimatter Reactors
levels.description: Huge power generation for ships and planets.

levels.name: Phasors
levels.description: Extremely powerful directed energy weapons.

levels.name: Omega Weapons
levels.description: Ultimate energy weapons capable of terrifying destruction.

levels.name: Ion Engines
levels.description: Improved ship speed.

levels.name: Hyperdrive I
levels.description: Increases maximum jump range.

levels.name: Inertial Stabilizers
levels.description: Better ship maneuverability in combat.

levels.name: Hyperdrive II
levels.description: Further range improvements + basic sensors.

levels.name: Warp Drive
levels.description: Very high speed engines.

levels.name: Mass Drivers
levels.description: Enables cheap planetary bombardment.

levels.name: Intergalactic Drive
levels.description: Extremely long range travel.

levels.name: Jump Gates
levels.description: Strategic movement network across the galaxy.

levels.name: Particle Beams
levels.description: Early advanced beam weapons.

levels.name: Nuclear Missiles
levels.description: First generation ship-to-ship missiles.

levels.name: Graviton Technology
levels.description: Gravity manipulation for weapons and utility.

levels.name: Antimatter Missiles
levels.description: Extremely powerful missile technology.

levels.name: Tachyon Weapons
levels.description: Fast, hard-hitting beam weapons.

levels.name: Plasma Torpedoes
levels.description: Slow but devastating area-effect torpedoes.

levels.name: Stellar Conversion
levels.description: Terrifying late-game planet-killing technology.

levels.name: Singularity Weapons
levels.description: Ultimate doomsday devices.

levels.name: Pollution Control
levels.description: Significantly reduces pollution generated by industry.

levels.name: Atmospheric Terraforming
levels.description: Increases maximum population on many planet types.

levels.name: Soil Enrichment
levels.description: Boosts food production and growth on marginal worlds.

levels.name: Advanced Terraforming
levels.description: Can turn many barren planets into habitable ones.

levels.name: Gaia Transformation
levels.description: Can transform suitable planets into rich Gaia worlds.

levels.name: Weather Control
levels.description: Stabilizes planetary environments.

levels.name: Eco-Restoration
levels.description: Can permanently remove heavy pollution from planets.

levels.name: Planetary Engineering
levels.description: Massive increases to maximum population on all worlds.

levels.name: Improved Government
levels.description: Better administration increases planetary happiness.

levels.name: Espionage Networks
levels.description: Unlocks basic spying and counter-espionage.

levels.name: Propaganda
levels.description: Reduces unhappiness caused by crowding and pollution.

levels.name: Cultural Exchange
levels.description: Improves diplomatic relations with other races.

levels.name: Mind Control
levels.description: Allows peaceful capture of enemy colonies in some cases.

levels.name: Universal Translator
levels.description: Major diplomatic bonuses and reduced misunderstandings.

levels.name: Galactic Unity
levels.description: Empire-wide happiness and shared research benefits.

levels.name: Transcendence
levels.description: Ultimate victory condition and enormous empire bonuses.
